name: ai-powered-fake-news-detector
description: Portfolio Full-Stack MERN + Python ML Microservice + LLM Misinformation Detector

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "ML,SERVER,CLIENT" -c "yellow,blue,green" "npm run start:ml" "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../ml-service && python -m venv venv && .\venv\Scripts\pip.exe install -r requirements.txt
